panels.title: Product source: hidden encoding
panels.quantity: Full-prior expected next-token regret on the same previously examined 3840 sequences.
panels.seed_rule: Main text uses fixed training run 1; both runs appear separately in the appendix. No seed pooling or selection.
panels.checkpoint_scope: The 4-layer model is final at 400,000 updates (25.6 million sequences). The 8-layer model is final at 400,000 updates (25.6 million sequences).
panels.bayes_unstructured_definition: Bayesian predictor that ignores the factorization: 16-state chain, independent rows, uniform (flat Dirichlet) prior; flat_dirichlet in comparison.json.

panels.title: Pooled sources
panels.quantity: Expected next-token regret: KL(true next-token distribution || predictor), in bits.
panels.scored_tokens: At time t, predict token t+1 given tokens 1 through t.
panels.family_weights: Posterior weights proportional to each family likelihood of the observed tokens.
panels.uncertainty: Equal-family mean; one stratified standard error across independent sequences.
panels.long_context_bayesian_comparison: Frozen complete-cohort estimates; numerical validation tracked separately

quantity_a_to_f: Expected next-token regret in bits: KL(true next-token distribution || predictor).
uncertainty: Plus/minus one standard error across independent complete test sequences. No training-seed pooling.
